title: Tool Over-Temperature Protection
shortDescription: Tool stopped due to overheated motor or electronics.
fullDescription: Hart 20V tools flash one LED on the fuel gauge when the motor or driver electronics exceed safe temperature. The tool will not restart until it cools below threshold.

fixSteps.title: Remove battery
fixSteps.instruction: Eject the 20V pack and let tool rest 15-20 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Clear vents
fixSteps.instruction: Blow compressed air through motor vents.

whenToCallPro: If tool overheats repeatedly within minutes of cool start.

title: Over-Current / Stall Trip
shortDescription: Electronic clutch tripped due to bit jam or stall.
fullDescription: Two-flash indicates excessive current draw, typically from a stalled bit or binding work. Release the trigger to reset.

fixSteps.title: Free the bit
fixSteps.instruction: Back out bit and replace if dull.

title: Low Battery Voltage
shortDescription: Battery pack voltage below operating threshold.
fullDescription: Three flashes indicate the 20V pack is below its low-voltage cutoff. Recharge before further use.

fixSteps.title: Recharge
fixSteps.instruction: Place pack on charger until full LED.

title: Battery Pack Communication Fault
shortDescription: Tool cannot read battery BMS data.
fullDescription: Four flashes mean the tool's controller cannot communicate with the battery's BMS. Reseat or try another pack.

fixSteps.title: Clean terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe both pack and tool contacts.

fixSteps.title: Try another pack
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm fault stays with pack or tool.

faq.a: Often yes if isolated to pack.

title: Trigger Switch Fault
shortDescription: Variable speed trigger sensor reading invalid.
fullDescription: Five flashes show a Hall effect or potentiometer reading from the trigger that is out of range, often from dust ingress.

title: MOSFET / Driver Stage Fault
shortDescription: Power output stage detected short or open.
fullDescription: Six flashes indicate the driver's gate-driver self-test failed. Usually a blown MOSFET from prior overload.

fixSteps.title: Submit warranty claim
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Hart support; module repair not field-serviceable.

title: Hall Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Brushless motor rotor position sensor invalid.
fullDescription: Seven flashes indicate the controller cannot read motor Hall sensors, preventing commutation.

fixSteps.title: Dry the tool
fixSteps.instruction: Leave in warm room 24h with battery out.

whenToCallPro: If drying does not clear code.

title: Controller Firmware Error
fullDescription: Eight flashes indicate the MCU detected a checksum or watchdog fault. Battery cycling can clear soft fault.

title: Charger Pack Fault
shortDescription: Charger refuses pack with rapid red flashing.
fullDescription: Hart chargers blink red rapidly when the inserted pack is too hot, too cold, or has a cell imbalance.

fixSteps.title: Cool pack
fixSteps.instruction: Wait 30 minutes at room temperature, retry.

faq.a: If cool pack still flashes, yes.

title: Tool Will Not Power On
shortDescription: No LEDs light when battery inserted.
fullDescription: Total dead-tool with confirmed-good pack often points to broken trigger pigtail or controller failure.

fixSteps.title: Inspect contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Look for bent or burnt terminals in tool foot.
